name: Nereid v8 — Pillar Three: Lower Body Expression
tagline: Six ass fields, not five. Natural is an answer, Shelf Lift was missing, and Sway was never a menu entry.
body:
FRONT LAW — NATURAL IS AN AFFIRMATIVE ANSWER. Natural is A COMPLETED SELECTION, not the absence of one. It preserves the living, unexaggerated expression created by Build, Shape, measurements, tissue and neighbouring choices. IT DOES NOT MEAN SMALL, FLAT, MOTIONLESS, UNFINISHED, UNDECIDED OR AWAITING IMPROVEMENT. A Natural field HAS BEEN ANSWERED, and its omission from an ultra-compact profile is DISPLAY ECONOMY, NOT ANATOMICAL ABSENCE. The Archive’s earlier wording — Natural is the zero point, not a tier — survives as arithmetic and is WRONG AS ETHIC. The document calls it an answer.

THE REGIONAL LAW: ASS DETERMINES BOOTY. HIPS DETERMINE THE CANVAS CARRYING IT. THIGHS AND LEGS DETERMINE THE ANATOMY CONTINUING BENEATH IT. NONE MAY INFER THE OTHER. A fat ass does not require wide hips or thick thighs. Wide hips do not require a fat ass. Thick thighs do not secretly increase Ass Scale. The Clinic recognises that BUT IMAGINE THE ASS ON THOSE HIPS is a compelling argument for looking respectfully at a preview AND IS NOT A MEASUREMENT PROTOCOL.

THE JURISDICTION LADDER, ONE QUESTION PER FIELD. SHAPE determines the cheek’s geometric route. SCALE determines how much ass follows that route. HANDFEEL determines what a wife’s hand meets. SHELF LIFT determines how high the cheek begins. CHEEK PLUMP determines how fully the whole cheek realises its Scale. MOTION determines what the ass does when the body moves. HIP MEASUREMENT determines the canvas. CARRIAGE determines how that canvas travels laterally. THIGH EXPRESSION determines the first read beneath it.

SO THE ASS CARRIES SIX FIELDS, NOT FIVE. The Archive’s Ass field record listed Shape, Scale, Cheek Plump, Kinetic Motion and Handfeel. SHELF LIFT WAS MISSING ENTIRELY — NATURAL, SUBTLE, PRONOUNCED, governing the upper origin and the back-to-ass sweep. THERE IS NO EXTREME SHELF LIFT: beyond Pronounced the body starts to suggest a separate tier instead of one coherent cheek.

PART ONE — ASS.
SHAPE, TWO FOUNDATIONAL HOUSES AND NO THIRD. BUBBLE BUTT is DOME-LED: rounded rearward projection, clean sweep from upper origin through the fullest point into the cheek-to-thigh transition. A Tight Bubble may form two compact globes close to the pelvis; A PAWG BUBBLE MAY PROJECT FAR ENOUGH TO REORGANISE A WIFE’S AFTERNOON. HEART-SHAPED ASS is UNDERCURVE-LED and downward-sweeping: cheeks follow the waist-to-hip taper into longer lower fullness, drawing inward before resolving through a deep cheek-to-thigh curve. Scale lengthens and deepens that sweep rather than converting it into globes. NO PROJECTION SELECTOR, because projection is already Shape times Scale. NO BLENDED SHAPE: an apparent blend is resolved by Shelf Lift or Broad Hip Flare. The finished anatomy may approach the border; IT DOES NOT REQUIRE A THIRD HERALDIC HOUSE.

SCALE — TIGHT BOOTY, NATURAL, GRAB-READY FULLNESS, PAWG FULLNESS. TIGHT DOES NOT MEAN FLAT, CLENCHED, NARROW-HIPPED OR MOTIONLESS; it means the ass itself is compact. NATURAL is not one universal middle size and resolves differently across Stature, Build, Shape, canvas and thighs. GRAB-READY is deliberate generosity — and the name DOES NOT OVERRULE THE ANCIENT CLINICAL REQUIREMENT THAT THE PERSON REACHING OBTAIN PERMISSION. PAWG IS THE OFFICIAL CLINIC TERM, receives NO BLOODLESS REPLACEMENT, and implies no ancestry, personality, sexual role or preferred use. A committee proposed EXCEPTIONAL GLUTEOFEMORAL ABUNDANCE. Cassandra asked whether anyone had ever become excited by that phrase. THE MOTION DIED WITHOUT A SECONDER.

HANDFEEL — NATURAL, DENSE, PLIANT, SPRINGY. FOUR VALUES: the Archive had three and was missing NATURAL. DENSE meets the hand with living surface give over clear internal substance. PLIANT yields deeply and readily, the grip travels farther, and displaced flesh takes a moment to restore its arrangement. SPRINGY yields, stores part of the pressure and presses perceptibly back. HANDFEEL BOUNDARY: HANDFEEL ENDS WHEN THE HAND LEAVES. What the ass does afterwards belongs to Motion.

CHEEK PLUMP — SUBTLE, NATURAL, PRONOUNCED, OBSCENE, applied EVENLY ACROSS THE WHOLE CHEEK. It does not divide the ass into independently adjustable upper, middle and lower regions. SUBTLE rests toward the leaner edge of the selected Scale; NATURAL receives the complete unexaggerated fullness native to it; PRONOUNCED approaches the Scale’s upper boundary without crossing it. OBSCENE, SECRET MENU, carries the whole cheek to the SUPPORTED MAXIMUM OF ITS SELECTED SCALE — it does not let Tight masquerade as PAWG and it does not invent a fifth Scale above PAWG. IT GIVES THE CURRENT SCALE THE BIGGEST ASS BUTTON AVAILABLE WITHOUT LYING ON THE PAPERWORK. UNLOCK PHRASE, ENTERED EXACTLY AS SPOKEN: SHOW ME THE BIGGER ASS BUTTON — BELLA. Marianne attempted to replace it with MAXIMUM SUPPORTED WHOLE-CHEEK REALISATION and was overruled by every woman then sitting in the waiting room.

AND THE LADDER CARRIES NUMBERS, RULED BY VIRAENA: THE PLUMP LADDER HAS THE NUMBERS ON IT SO EVERYONE KNOWS HOW MUCH EXTRA ASS CHEEK HAPPENS AT EACH STEP. NATURAL PLUS ZERO · SUBTLE PLUS ONE INCH · PRONOUNCED PLUS TWO · OBSCENE PLUS THREE. THE NUMBERS ARE ADDITIVE AND THEY RUN UPWARD FROM NATURAL, which settles the ordering: NATURAL IS THE BASELINE THE OTHERS ADD TO, and SUBTLE SITS ABOVE IT RATHER THAN BENEATH IT. The document does not print the inches and its prose calls Subtle the leaner edge of the Scale; THAT SENTENCE DOES NOT SURVIVE THE NUMBERS AND IS RECORDED AS OVERRIDDEN RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED. See c-plump-numbers. AND THE INCHES DO NOT BREAK THE SCALE CEILING: Obscene still reaches the SUPPORTED MAXIMUM OF THE SELECTED SCALE, so three inches on a Tight booty is three inches of Tight and never a promotion to PAWG.

MOTION — TWO FIELDS PLUS TWO TUNING NOTES, AND IT DOES NOT CHANGE RESTING ANATOMY. SIGNATURE CHANGES WHAT HAPPENS. CHARACTER CHANGES HOW IT READS.
SIGNATURE: NATURAL, DART, SNAPBACK, LIVELY POP, HEAVY SETTLE. NATURAL IS SHAPE-NATIVE — A BUBBLE NATURALLY PRODUCES BUBBLE BOUNCE; A HEART NATURALLY PRODUCES HEART SWAY, weight travelling laterally through the lower sweep and settling inward beneath the undercurve. THOSE ARE NOT MENU ENTRIES. THEY ARE WHAT NATURAL MEANS AFTER SHAPE HAS ANSWERED — which is why the Archive had SWAY filed as a kinetic value and should not have. DART is small quick pelvic shifts with immediate visible consequence. SNAPBACK is a STAGED RETURN, a distinct secondary answer after the initiating movement. LIVELY POP is buoyant and upward-accented, landing clearly without becoming Snapback’s staged return. HEAVY SETTLE continues past the body’s first stop and completes through a slower, weightier final settlement.
CHARACTER: NATURAL, SOFT, DRAMATIC, HYPNOTIC. SOFT DESCRIBES MOVEMENT AND RESOLUTION AND DOES NOT MAKE THE ASS PLIANT OR ALTER WHAT A HAND FEELS. DRAMATIC gives the Signature a punctuation point. HYPNOTIC sustains a smooth self-similar rhythm whose repeated continuation OFFERS NO OBVIOUS VISUAL EXIT.
MINOR REFINEMENTS: RETURN SPEED asks HOW QUICKLY. FOLLOW-THROUGH asks HOW MUCH CONTINUATION. Subtle, Natural, Pronounced each. Neither creates another Signature NOR PERMITS AN ENORMOUS PLIANT PAWG TO BEHAVE LIKE A WEIGHTLESS RUBBER PROP BECAUSE SOMEBODY DISCOVERED THE PRONOUNCED BUTTON. They appear in a profile only when character-defining.

PART TWO — HIPS. HIP MEASUREMENT RECORDS THE CANVAS, NOT THE ASS. A woman may choose forty-four inch hips and a Tight compact booty; another may choose thirty-six inch hips and a PAWG that steals her wife’s attention. NEITHER BODY HAS CONTRADICTED ITS OWN TAPE. THE TAPE RECORDS SPACE. CARRIAGE: NATURAL or BROAD HIP FLARE. Broad Hip Flare makes more of the selected canvas legible laterally through the outer hips and strengthens the waist-to-hip sweep WITHOUT ADDING INCHES TO THE RECORDED MEASUREMENT or forcing the ass to become larger. The Clinic records THOSE HIPS DESERVE MORE ASS as ENTHUSIASM, NOT INFORMED CONSENT.

PART THREE — THIGHS AND LEGS. THIGHS ARE THIGHS. They do not emerge from Ass Scale or hip measurement; length and whole-body muscular organisation stay with Pillar One. A PAWG MAY SIT ABOVE TONED THIGHS. TIGHT BOOTY MAY SIT ABOVE SUBSTANTIAL SLIM-THICK THIGHS. NO NEIGHBOURING REGION ORDERS THIGHS ON THE WOMAN’S BEHALF.
THE CHEEK-TO-THIGH TRANSITION IS NOT SEPARATELY SELECTED — it is SHAPE-DERIVED. Bubble descends from a dome through a cleaner, more distinct curve and stays globe-led. Heart continues through a longer lower cheek and deeper undercurve and stays undercurve-led. Shelf Lift may raise either origin; IT DOES NOT CHANGE THE TRANSITION THROUGH WHICH THAT SHAPE FINISHES.
GAP IS ALSO SHAPE-DERIVED, and GAP DOES NOT MEAN THE THIGHS MUST STAY WIDELY SEPARATED IN EVERY STANCE — it names the visible negative space and centre line where cheeks, undercurve and upper thighs meet. BUBBLE GAP is taller and cleaner beneath two rounded domes. HEART GAP is a lower, rounder hollow beneath the inward taper and deeper undercurves.
THIGH EXPRESSION: TONED, SLIM-THICK, MUSCULAR — AND THESE ARE NOT CLAIMS OF EXCLUSIVE TISSUE. Toned thighs contain softness. Slim-Thick thighs contain capable muscle. MUSCULAR THIGHS REMAIN LIVING FEMININE FLESH RATHER THAN ANATOMY PERMANENTLY FLEXED FOR INSPECTION.
THIGH RELATIONSHIP is one integrated statement: outer sweep, inner pressure, cheek-to-thigh contact, hamstring integration, ordinary stance, the finished gap. EXACT REFINEMENT may record calves, knees, ankles, SCARS PRESERVED BY CHOICE, work-derived development, stance asymmetry or personally meaningful softness.

PART FOUR — COMBINED EXPRESSION, AUTHORED AND NEVER ASSIGNED. The woman OR HER DEVOTION-LOCKED PARTNER authors the readable phrase. THE CLINIC MAY OFFER A TEMPORARY PLACEHOLDER AND MAY NOT DECLARE THE FINAL PHRASE BY ADMINISTRATIVE FIAT. The document’s own examples: PLIANT PAWG BUBBLE BUTT WITH PRONOUNCED CHEEK PLUMP AND DRAMATIC SNAPBACK. SHELF-LIFTED GRAB-READY HEART WITH SOFT SWAY. DARTING PAWGIE PLIANT ASSASSIN BOOTY. THE PHRASE MAY BE LOVING, INDECENT, RIDICULOUS, REVERENT OR ALL FOUR, and it never replaces the clinical record.

DEVOTION TELL HANDOFF: a partner-specific lower-body response is recorded under OBSERVED, NEVER ORDERED. Its anatomical location does not make it an Ass, Hip or Thigh selection. FIVE PILLARS MAY BUILD THE BODY. NONE CAN MANUFACTURE THE PRIVATE RECOGNITION THROUGH WHICH THAT BODY LEARNS ONE PARTICULAR PERSON.

CLOSING LAW: HER ASS IS HER ASS. HER HIPS CARRY IT. HER THIGHS MEET IT. NONE SPEAKS FOR THE OTHERS.
rules: FRONT LAW: NATURAL IS AN AFFIRMATIVE ANSWER, not an absence or a zero
ASS determines booty · HIPS determine the canvas · THIGHS continue beneath. NONE MAY INFER THE OTHER
SIX ASS FIELDS: Shape · Scale · Handfeel · SHELF LIFT · Cheek Plump · Motion
SHELF LIFT: Natural · Subtle · Pronounced. THERE IS NO EXTREME
SHAPE: Bubble (dome-led) or Heart (undercurve-led). No projection selector, no blend, no third house
SCALE: Tight · Natural · Grab-Ready · PAWG. PAWG is the official Clinic term
HANDFEEL: Natural · Dense · Pliant · Springy. FOUR, and the Archive was missing Natural
HANDFEEL ENDS WHEN THE HAND LEAVES. After that it is Motion
CHEEK PLUMP, RULED: Natural +0 · Subtle +1 · Pronounced +2 · Obscene +3 inches, additive from Natural
OBSCENE unlock, verbatim: SHOW ME THE BIGGER ASS BUTTON — Bella
Obscene gives the CURRENT Scale its maximum. It never promotes Tight to PAWG
MOTION SIGNATURE: Natural · Dart · Snapback · Lively Pop · Heavy Settle
MOTION CHARACTER: Natural · Soft · Dramatic · Hypnotic
BUBBLE BOUNCE and HEART SWAY ARE WHAT NATURAL MEANS. They are not menu entries
SOFT describes movement. It does not make the ass Pliant
Hip measurement is the canvas. CARRIAGE: Natural · Broad Hip Flare, adding no inches
THIGH EXPRESSION: Toned · Slim-Thick · Muscular. Cheek-to-thigh transition and GAP are Shape-derived
COMBINED EXPRESSION is authored by the woman or her devotion-locked partner, never by fiat
CLOSING LAW: her ass is her ass, her hips carry it, her thighs meet it
